body:
FIX ROUND 1 (OPENING) (B-COHORTPUSH-123, agent 123) — growth-project-backend#757 @ 0856638c9d2609780ef62b61fedac4025d9bc69a

Job: F11, C-S-PUSH-4 from S-PUSH-123 (group chat messages never send a push). One backend PR on main e9b82e13.

**Normal-user story fixed:** a client posts in their cohort group chat; every other member with the app closed now gets a "Community / New community message" push instead of nothing.

**What changed (365 changed lines, 11 files, under 1,500)**
- `src/community/messages/community-messages.service.ts` — `send` ends with fire-and-forget `pushCohortMessage` after the write and realtime ping. One `COMMUNITY_MESSAGE_RECEIVED` push per recipient through the existing `CommunityNotificationsService.sendCommunityPush` (flag, "Mute all notifications" since b#751, token and lock-screen privacy gates all stay there). Input: `targetType=message`, `targetId=<message id>`, `deepLink=tgp://community/cohorts/<cohort id>`, no body context, so the body stays the fixed "New community message". Skips both block directions with the sender (`hiddenFromViewer`) and notify level `quiet`. Lookup errors are caught and logged through `describeFailure` (no exception text); the send never fails.
- `src/community/messages/community-messages.repository.ts` — `listCohortPushRecipients`: active memberships of the write result's cohort, minus the sender, minus active workspace bans (`bannedAmong`).
- `src/community/notifications/community-notifications.service.ts` — `pushEnabled()` made public so the fan-out skips its lookup when community push is off.
- No new retry, queue, schema or lockfile change.

**Tests (failing first)**
- New `test/community/messages/community-messages-push.service.spec.ts`, 8 cases over the real repository and real block filter: other active members only with ids + deep link and no message text; never the sender; skips removed, muted, invited and other-cohort rows; skips a workspace-banned member; skips both block directions; skips `quiet`; no lookup when push is off; send still returns when the lookup fails. On main: 6 failing. With the fix: 8/8.
- Constructor arity: 4 unit specs (shared `noCommunityPush()` helper) and 2 live-DB e2e provider lists (push stub, off). Local runs via heavy.sh: coach-reply 4/4, challenges cross-surface 11/11, safety-flow 14/14, block-two-way 75/75. R75 local range check: net 0 per class. `test/privacy/no-pii-in-logs.spec.ts` 11/11 locally after the `describeFailure` fix.

**CI**
Commits: a5c3ce99 (fix + spec), af9a0af2 (R75: specs use a typed `stub<T>()` and a shared `noCommunityPush()`, no new cast tokens), 0856638c (log line uses `describeFailure`).
- At 0856638c (09:57 PDT): Banned cast tokens (R75) green, danger, build-sbom, rls-floor-guard, test-deploy-readiness green; build-and-test, community-live-tests, rls-live-tests, mwb-3-live-tests, Schema parity, CodeQL still running.
- At af9a0af2: type-check, lint and build green; full suite 2 failing files out of 876: `test/privacy/no-pii-in-logs.spec.ts` (my new warn line printed exception text; fixed in 0856638c) and `test/booking-lock-screen-push.spec.ts` ("tomorrow" vs "today" reminder line; not touched by this PR, fails the same way on #756 and #758 today, clock-dependent on main). community-live-tests green.
- `npm audit (high+critical, whole graph)` red on main e9b82e13 as well: new critical `shell-quote` advisory GHSA-pqg4-j6r4-53mv with no exception. Pre-existing, outside this PR (lockfile).

**Operator decisions (defaults applied)**
1. `notify_level` `digest` (the column default; no endpoint writes it today) pushes like `live`; only `quiet` is skipped. Treating `digest` as no-push would mean no member ever gets a group chat push. Default: keep.
2. The workspace coach is pushed only when they hold an active membership row in the cohort (brief: cohort members); client messages still reach the coach inbox. Default: keep.

**Cs (follow-up, not fixed)**
- C: core `createNotification` returns null for community kinds (digest preference prefix, push default false), so `sendCommunityPush` pushes but writes no inbox row and its replay guard never finds one. Pre-existing for DMs and replies too.
- C: the mobile app has no `tgp://community` deep-link route yet; a tap opens the app, same as every other community push.

READY FOR AUDIT (build-and-test at 0856638c still running; the two red items above that are not this PR's need operator action)

FIX ROUND 2 (B-COHORTPUSH-123, agent 123) — growth-project-backend#757 @ 3a17123243f3df93f838367a676a797b6fdc2930

Delta from 0856638c: main merged into the branch only (update-branch; brings #759, which fixes the two required checks that failed on main). No source change.
PR CI at this head: all required checks SUCCESS (build-and-test and npm audit included).

READY FOR AUDIT
